integrity: The proof derives matching lower and upper bounds. The lower bound uses the published coordinate-symmetric necessity criterion; the upper bound proves a uniform Steiner-symmetrization square inclusion by an exact support-line chord identity in both N modulo 8 cases. The N=6 and N=10 specializations exactly reproduce the published values.
scientific_limitations: The formula is restricted to regular polygons with N congruent to 2 modulo 4, circumradius one, the standard integer lattice, and the lattice-point covering property under arbitrary rotations and translations. Odd regular polygons and other lattices are not treated.
title: Exact lattice-point covering radii for all regular polygons with two modulo four sides
